criteria.detail: Clipboard handling is centralized, source/origin validated, user initiated, manually fallback-capable, and never routed through RPC, storage, logs, or CLI arguments.
Only the latest inline viewer streams, minimized or hidden viewers unmount, and expanded control keeps one iframe.
GitHub, Linear, and Google records are project scoped, explicitly user confirmed, refreshable, editable, timestamped, and removable.
Service login navigation is constrained to the fixed HTTPS catalog and does not change engine policy or invoke models.
The shared toolbar and responsive account/session layout pass desktop and mobile overflow checks.
The review packet does not itself include durable execution evidence for focused checks, full workspace checks, installed integration, and push completion.

securityCorrectness: Pass: no material product security or correctness defect was found.
designMaintainability: Pass: the shared viewer, sign-in persistence, catalog, and request coalescing boundaries are maintainable. Medium F-1: AC-5 needs durable verification evidence.
